biggest_catch: Your 9.5% commission is earned, not guaranteed — every order cancellation docks 10 rating points, and a rating below 90 pushes commission to 15–25%.
catches: 9.5% commission + $5 seller fee (US; Canada 12.4%) + 2.9% cash-out fee on ACH/PayPal deposits — three stacked fees.
Seller rating starts at 90; each cancellation −10 points raises commission to 15%, 20%, or 25%; below 50 = suspension.
GOAT Clean (cleaning service) fees of 25–30% are separate — don't confuse them with marketplace fees.
2.9% cash-out fee applies even on ACH; promotional free-ACH campaigns happen occasionally.
Items must pass authentication before the buyer gets them.

maximize: Protect your seller rating like cash: never cancel a confirmed order — one cancellation costs 10 points and can move you from 9.5% to 15% commission, which on a $200 sale is an $11 difference per order. Confirm orders within 24 hours and ship authentic items on time to earn the +2 points per sale back. Take the 2.9% cash-out fee into account when pricing; watch for GOAT's promotional free-ACH campaigns. Unlike StockX, GOAT allows used sneakers — that's the inventory edge: worn-once pairs others won't list go here, deadstock goes to StockX for its better fee tier.

s6.note: 5 steps: list, sell, ship for authentication, authentication, cash out.

steps: List new or used sneakers/apparel (no listing fee)
When your item sells, confirm within 24 hours
Ship to GOAT with the provided label for authentication
GOAT authenticates and delivers to the buyer
Cash out earnings over $25 via ACH or PayPal (2.9% fee)
timing: Paid after authentication; cash-out available at $25+ earnings
who_pays: The buyer pays through GOAT, and GOAT releases your earnings after the item passes authentication.
who_qualifies: Anyone 18+; new and used sneakers/apparel must pass GOAT authentication.
work_available: GOAT is active and open to new sellers.
what_gets_accepted: Items must pass GOAT's authentication. Your seller rating starts at 90 — each cancellation costs 10 points and raises your commission to 15%, 20%, or 25%; drop below 50 and you're suspended.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Three stacked fees: 9.5% commission + $5 seller fee (US) + 2.9% cash-out fee on ACH/PayPal deposits. Unpaid time goes to listing and shipping for authentication.
when_cash_arrives: After authentication, cash out once you have $25+ in earnings — via ACH or PayPal, each with a 2.9% cash-out fee.
